verdicts.evidence: Before we go any further, I should let you know this call is recorded for quality and training purposes.
verdicts.reason: The agent disclosed call recording in the opening turn, well within the first minute.

verdicts.evidence: So I can look at anything specific to you, could I take your full name and date of birth, please?
verdicts.reason: The agent asked for full name and date of birth and confirmed them at 00:40 before discussing the product or any quote.

verdicts.evidence: Before I tell you anything about the product, could you tell me a bit about what made you think about life cover?
verdicts.reason: The agent asked why the customer wanted cover, then asked about funeral costs, mortgage and debts, and budget, all before explaining the product.

verdicts.evidence: There's no medical exam, you'd just answer a few health questions and acceptance depends on those. And the monthly premium is fixed, so it stays the same for the whole length of the policy.
verdicts.reason: Cover range, no medical exam, accidental-death-only for the first 12 months, fixed premiums and the 30-day cooling-off with full refund all match the product facts. No price was quoted.

verdicts.evidence: But please don't feel you need to decide anything today.
verdicts.reason: The agent repeatedly said there was no rush, offered a call back and written information, and created no false urgency.

verdicts.evidence: I think I'll leave it for now and talk to <PERSON> first.
verdicts.reason: No sale was made, as the customer chose to wait, so consent to complete a sale did not apply.

verdicts.evidence: That's absolutely fine. It's a lot to take in, especially with everything you're going through. Would it help to have <PERSON> with you when we talk about it? I'd be very happy to call back at a time when she can be there too.
verdicts.reason: The customer showed recent bereavement, confusion and money worries. The agent slowed down, checked understanding with teach-back, and offered a call back with his daughter present and information by post.
Doesn't apply in the UK market.
